summary: Backend tests for the new 'Selisih Galon Merah/Hijau' feature. Verified POST/PATCH /api/warehouse/daily photo fields, GET /api/warehouse/discrepancy (merah/hijau/summary), clear-hijau + restore-hijau, RBAC (gudang/sales/wrong-group admin → 403), and regression on /warehouse/stock + /expenses. New file: /app/backend/tests/test_discrepancy.py. All 6 tests PASS (parallel-safe with xdist loadscope).

checks: POST /api/warehouse/daily (gudang1) with 4 photo_* data URIs → 200, all 4 fields persisted
GET /api/warehouse/daily verifies photos present in list
PATCH photo_isi_pagi='' → 200, field unset in response, other 3 photos preserved, edit_count=1
PATCH sisa_pagi=8 → merah=0, hijau=1, hijau_raw=1, hijau_cleared=False
POST /clear-hijau (adminA, same group A) → 200; GET → hijau=0, hijau_raw=1, hijau_cleared=True
clear-hijau as adminB (group B) for A1 entry (group A) → 403 'Bukan wilayah Anda'
2 days for A1: day1 merah=3, day2 hijau=2 → summary[0].total_merah=3, total_hijau=2, days_merah=1, days_hijau=1
GET /api/warehouse/stock (gudang1) → 200 with expected keys (galon, seal, mur, kran)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2743 lines — splitting into modules (auth, transactions, warehouse, discrepancy, admin) will simplify maintenance. Not blocking.
clear-hijau/restore-hijau operate on all entries in (sales_id,date) via update_many — matches the summary aggregation design. Correct.
_compute_discrepancy_for_date silently coerces None/'' → 0 via `or 0` — resilient to sparse docs. Good defensive coding.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed. Tests write to fixed past dates (2020-01-13..17) for sales A1 and clean up via super_admin DELETE in per-class autouse fixtures (parallel-safe with xdist loadscope).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest backend/tests/test_discrepancy.py -v. Tests use per-class autouse cleanup so each class owns its own test date (DATE_PHOTO=01-16, DATE_T3=01-15, DATE_T4=01-17, DATE_T5_A/B=01-13/14) for parallel isolation. If flaky, run with `-o addopts=''` for serial. Sales A1 UUID hardcoded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: n/a — all requested endpoints pass on first serial run. Initial parallel failures were test-infrastructure only (module-scoped cleanup fixture ran twice due to xdist loadscope splitting classes across workers); resolved by moving cleanup to per-class autouse fixtures scoped to each class's own dates.
